text:
Haan, please human agent se connect karo, ya phir ise properly escalate karo. 

Problem yeh hui hai ki courier waale ne kisi aur building mein deliver kar diya hai. Mera apartment complex hai, aur usne building B mein chhod diya jabki main building D mein rehta hoon. 

Aapko kisi ko toh bhejna padega wahan recovery ke liye, ya phir courier boy ko bolkar correct building mein re-deliver karwao. Already ₹5,999 ka item hai, main aise hi thodi jaane dunga. Please isko escalate karo aur jaldi solution do.
